title: Short Stirling LK276
memorial_details: Rectangular plaque, fixed to a cast iron and wooden bench. The plaque has the Royal Air Force crest at top left and the 190 Squadron crest at top right; beneath is the inscription in white lettering. The ends of the bench have the coloured crest of Great Dunmow Town Council.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ Flight Sergeant/ ARTHUR GEORGE REID/ aged 33/ Killed with the rest of his crew, when Short Stirling bomber LK276/ crashed near this location on 21st November 1944,/ as the result of enemy action.
original_title: Flight Sergeant A G Reid and crew of Short Stirling LK276
